title: Surreal Rainy Chamber
description: A man in a dark suit sits at a small table inside a dilapidated room with water pouring through a broken skylight. A giant melting purple and orange hot air balloon hovers inside the flooded room while an endless hallway with red lighting is visible through a large framed painting on the wall.
prompt: A surreal scene inside a decaying classical room with water pouring from a broken skylight onto a flooded floor. A man in a black suit sits at a small table looking at a large framed painting that shows an endless hallway with red lighting. A giant melting purple and orange hot air balloon with dripping texture floats inside the room, dramatic lighting, moody atmosphere, cinematic surrealism
